mapper.select:
SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT L.*, C.NAME, C.REMARK, F.NAME FILENAME, F.BIZCATEGORY, F.ID AS FILEID FROM T_CORE_REPORT_CONFIG_LINE L LEFT JOIN T_CORE_REPORT_CONFIG C ON L.REPORTCONFIGID = C.ID LEFT JOIN T_CORE_FILE F ON F.TARGETID = 'T_CORE_REPORT_CONFIG_LINE$' + CONVERT(VARCHAR, L.ID)
AND F.BIZCATEGORY = #{filter_bizCategory}
WHERE 1 = 1) T
ORDER BY
T.REPORTCONFIGID, T.ORDERNO, T.ID

SELECT * FROM (SELECT A.*, B.NAME, B.CATEGORY, C.NAME AS FILENAME FROM T_CORE_REPORT_CONFIG_LINE A LEFT JOIN T_CORE_REPORT_CONFIG B ON B.ID = A.REPORTCONFIGID LEFT JOIN T_CORE_FILE C ON C.TARGETID = 'T_CORE_REPORT_CONFIG_LINE$' + CONVERT(VARCHAR, A.ID)) T
OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_CORE_ROLE_PERMISSION P WHERE P.PERMISSIONTYPEID = 'T_CORE_REPORT_CONFIG_LINE' AND P.ROLEID = #{loginUser.ext$.loginroleid} AND P.TARGETID = T.ID AND T.CATEGORY = 'select' AND T.ACTIVATEDFLAG = '1')
OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_CORE_ROLE_PERMISSION P LEFT JOIN T_CORE_ROLE_USER RU ON RU.ROLEID = P.ROLEID WHERE P.PERMISSIONTYPEID = 'T_CORE_REPORT_CONFIG_LINE' AND RU.USERID = #{loginUser.id} AND P.TARGETID = T.ID AND T.CATEGORY = 'select' AND T.ACTIVATEDFLAG = '1')
ORDER BY T.ORDERNO, T.ID
